* '''Original''' ([[Kamino]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-kamino-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/kamino.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Kamino site.” Dark Side: “If opponent has two clones on table, Force drain -1 here.” '''What changed:''' before release: the lower-left margin (underlying card) “Malastare (Light)” became “Aquaris”; re-rendered with sharper graphics; same words.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kamino (Errata)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-kamino.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/kamino.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Kamino site.” Dark Side: “If opponent has two clones on table, Force drain -1 here.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; new planet artwork on a starfield; re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
